dict.string: Atlas uses the camera to scan food barcodes, take a profile photo (stored locally), and photograph meals for nutrition estimation. Meal photos are sent securely to our AI service for analysis and are not retained after the response. Barcode and profile photos stay on your device.
Atlas uses Face ID to optionally lock the app, so your protocols and health data stay private if your device is unlocked. Face ID is optional — you can disable it in Settings.
Atlas reads heart rate, HRV, resting heart rate, body mass, steps, and active energy from Apple Health to correlate your peptide protocols with biometric trends. All analysis happens on your device.

Atlas can optionally write the meals you log (calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber) to Apple Health, so your nutrition shows up alongside everything else Apple Health tracks. Writing is off by default and you can disable it any time in Profile → Apple Health.

Atlas can save your generated share cards (cycle summaries, achievement cards) to your Photo Library when you tap Save. Only the images you choose to save are written — Atlas never reads from your library.
